collections.title: Benelux
collections.description: Belgium, the Netherlands and Luxembourg: three countries a train crosses in a day.

collections.title: The Baltic States
collections.description: Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania: three medieval capitals, Tallinn, Riga and Vilnius, a bus ride apart.

collections.title: The Nordic Countries
collections.description: Denmark, Finland, Iceland, Norway and Sweden: fjords, saunas, the midnight sun and the northern lights.

collections.title: Europe's Microstates
collections.description: The six smallest countries in Europe, from Malta to Vatican City, which is smaller than New York's Central Park. Each is an easy add to a bigger trip.

collections.title: Central America
collections.description: The seven countries on the land bridge from Mexico to Colombia, Belize to Panama: volcanoes, cloud forest and two oceans a day's drive apart.

collections.title: The Caribbean
collections.description: The thirteen island nations of the Caribbean, from Cuba and Jamaica to Grenada and Barbados. Cruise ports count as long as you went ashore.

collections.title: Southeast Asia
collections.description: The eleven countries from Myanmar to Timor-Leste: the backpacker loop through Thailand, Vietnam and Cambodia, and the islands beyond it.

collections.title: The European Union
collections.description: The 27 member states of the EU, from Ireland to Cyprus. Most share a currency and open borders, so they add up faster than you'd think.
